questions.question: The prophet Micah said the remnant of Jacob among many peoples would be like what?
The prophet Micah said the remnant of Jacob among the nations would be like what?

answers.text: A lion among the forest beasts

questions.question: Through the prophet Micah, why did the LORD say He would cut off the carved images and sacred pillars?

answers.text: So the people stop bowing to their own handiwork
So the land has room for more crops
So the nations cannot carry them off

questions.question: Through the prophet Micah, which nations did the LORD say He would take vengeance on in anger and wrath?

answers.text: The ones that have not obeyed Him
The ones that lie closest to Israel
The ones that have never been warned
